title: Understanding OLS
text: In an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model, the goal is to minimize the sum of the squared differences between the observed values and the values predicted by the model.

title: Residuals in OLS
text: The residual vector, often denoted as $e$, represents the difference between the observed values and the predicted values in the model.

title: Orthogonality in OLS
text: In the context of OLS, orthogonality refers to the residual vector being perpendicular to the span of the design matrix $X$. This is a key property of the OLS solution.

hintAnswer: The residual vector e is orthogonal to the span of X.
title: Identifying True Statements
text: Which statement about the residual vector $e$ is true in the context of OLS?
choices: Y and hat{theta} have the same dimensionality.
